Inspection 
every 2 month
Before isolated the pump mechanically and electrically

rows:
Check any noise or vibration in pump, pump gearbox and main 
 gear box.
Check any leakage from the piping connections to the pump.

Check the amount of leakage from stuffing box and prevented 
 it by
 retighten the gland bolts but it must leaks some drops (50 drop/min) to cool 
 the gland.
Check any leakage of lubricating oil in pumps gearbox
Check any leakage of lubricating oil in main gearbox.
Check the oil level in pump gearbox.
Check the oil level in main gearbox
Check the pressure in the pumps delivery.
Check the temperature of all bearing houses.

sections.text: After isolated the pump mechanically and electrically

rows:
Check the coupling pins and changed the inserts of 
 carrying pins (polyamide) if needed..

Check the packing if there is more leakage and did 
 not prevent by tighten the gland bolts

Prevent the leakage of lubricating oil in pumps 
 gearbox

Prevent leakage of lubricating oil in main 
 gearbox.

Add lubricating oil to main gearbox if oil level 
 less than 2/3 oil side glass

Add lubricating oil to pumps gearbox if oil level 
 less than 2/3 oil side glass

Retighten the bolts connected pump, pumps 
 gearbox, main gearbox and motor with foundation

Check the alignment between pump, main gearbox and 
 main gearbox, motor

sections.text:
Inspection every 6 month: 
Before isolated the pump mechanically and electrically

rows: Check any noise or vibration in pump, pumps gear box and main gear box

Check the amount of 
 leakage from stuffing box and minimized it by retighten the gland bolts and 
 keep some drops (50 drops/ min) for cooling
Check any leakage from the pipes connections to the pump
Check leakage of lubricating oil in pumps gearbox
Check leakage of lubricating oil in main gearbox.
Check the oil level in pumps gearbox
Check the oil level in main gearbox.
Check the pressure in the pumps delivery.
Check the temperature of all bearing house, it must be less than 70 C

sections.text: After isolated the pump mechanically and electrically

rows:
Check the rotating pistons from mechanical wear and measure 
 the clearances
Check the bearings in pump , pumps gearbox

Change the packing if leakage is heavy and didnt prevented 
 by tighten the gland bolts.

Prevent the leakage of lubricating oil in pumps gearbox and 
 main gearbox.
Change the lubricating oil in pumps and main gearbox.

Check the couplings pins and changed the inserts of 
 carrying pins (Polyamide) if needed

Check the alignment between pump main gearbox and main 
 gearbox motor.

Retighten all bolts connected pump, pumps gearbox, main 
 gearbox and
 motor with foundation.

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document out lines the details equipment inspection steps 
 I1, required for
horizontal volume displacement pump with rotating pistons with a supporting bearing.which 
 must be performed every 2 and 6 month as indicated by M2, M6 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by director eng. Saad Mostafa, and revised by 
quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by general director eng. Ali Al-Lithy
and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam: Head Sector of Talkha Steam 
Power Station 2x210MW
Technical specification of Unloading 
 Mazot PUMP
No. of pump | 5 
 (OPD11,12,13,14and15) D001
Pump type | SIGMA 150-RPP-4000-101-LN-17
Gear pox type | TSA 031301 03 3 5.6 x 1500
Delivered quantity (L/S) | 17.3
Pressure in delivery( Mpa) | 0.6
Pump speed (rpm) | 260
Recommended oil type for pumps gear box | DTE 105
Equivalent oil type for pumps gear box | Misr compressor oil 50
Quantity of oil for pumps gear box (L) | 3
Exchange interval for pumps gear box (hr) | 2000
Recommended oil type for main gear box | Mobil gear oil 630
Equivalent oil type for main gear box | Misr industrial gear oil p - 220
Quantity of oil for main gear box (L) | 4
Exchange interval for main gear box (hr) | 2000
Flexible coupling type | BKN-250 (Between 
 pumps shaft and out gearbox shaft)
 BKN 160 (Between motor shaft and in gearbox shaft)
Pump, gear box, motor shaft Diameter (mm) | ( 63 , 85 42 , 55 ) H7
Pump, gear box, motor weight (Kg) | 510 , 120 , 430
Safety Precautions
Isolate the 
circuit breaker for the motor of this pump.
The pump must 
be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery
valve.
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
Isolate the 
circuit breaker for the motor of this pump.
The pump must 
be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery
valve.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning 
fluid, Feeler gauge.
Suitable lifting device.

8 | Check the pressure in the pumps delivery. | 0.6 Mpa | 
9 | Check the temperature of all bearing houses. | < 70 C |
